command.name: Feral Strike
verbatim: After each Basic Attack: deal 2 instances of Physical Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane (Damage Rate: +20%). Each damage instance selects its target separately.
Rounds 4, 6, 8: 30% chance to gain Double-Strike for 2 round(s).
At 6 Stars: Basic Attacks deal Physical Damage to the Enemy with the least troops (Damage Rate: +40%); the Double-Strike chance becomes 50%.

vanguard.name: Warrior's Zeal
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase Physical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Hunter's Bane
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Intelligence by -36% (enhanced by Strength) of 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes Hunters) until the end of combat.

habits.name: Dragon's Might
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Physical Damage Dealt (excluding Basic Attacks) by +25% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Feral Precision
verbatim: Feral Strike gains: After each Basic Attack: Deal Physical Damage to the enemy with the least troops (Damage Rate: +40%).
Rounds 4, 6, 8: The chance to gain Double-Strike is increased to 50%.

habits.name: Armor Break
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase the Physical Damage Received by +8% of 1 opposing Enemy until the end of combat.

habits.name: Desperate Ambush
habits.verbatim: Each Round: If you are below 50% troop capacity, deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritizes Hunters) (Damage Rate: +60%). Additionally, there is a 12% chance to afflict the target with Overwhelm for 2 round(s).
